confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Colombo's tourist price levels; no live listings, menus, or booking pages were consulted, and no web search was used for city prices. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately reliable, while hotel rates vary widely by season and property. Sri Lanka's heavy alcohol taxes make drink prices less certain, and draft-specific beer pricing is uncertain; cocktail (about 2.5x beer) and wine glass (about 2.2x beer) use the local beer relationship because direct bar-price knowledge is weak. The FX value came from web search summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: South Asian tourist price levels, adjusted upward for Colombo's tourist-facing hotels and restaurants and for Sri Lanka's heavy alcohol taxes; no single comparable city was used as a direct benchmark.
